text:
olivia-partners: Quick check-in: vendor roadmaps shifted slightly. We need to finalize interconnect fallback rules and SI dry-run cadence for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi so marketplace and integrators don't get surprised.

ben-eng: Noted. Main technical risk is MI300 image signing and Gaudi driver ABI drift. Both could block marketplace image certification.

tara-products: Proposal: three-phase cadence
- Phase 0: early integrator dry-run (no public listing)
- Phase 1: soft listing + limited press in primary regions
- Phase 2: GA open listing
This keeps integrators happy while not overpromising.

ken-ops: For interconnect fallbacks, recommend policy: prefer local region capacity, fallback to nearest region within same continent, else use cross-continent but tag traffic and SLA. Example fallback chain: us-east -> us-west -> eu-west. We should embed this in marketplace routing metadata.

sri-sre: Canary suggestion: run a sequence of load profiles for each SKU for 6 hours (burst, sustained, idle) and check thermal/PCIe errors. If any ECC errors, auto-rollback firmware using the last-known-good image.

vendor-hw-bot: Vendor note: H200 test images will land W+2; MI300 debug kernel is still perf-tuning. Expect vendor SDK v1.2 by vendor ETA W+1.

olivia-partners: Thanks. Two immediate asks: 1) Integrators want a fixed window for SDK downloads and lab access. Can we commit to 72h SDK drop before Phase 1? 2) We need to publish a fallback routing policy doc to partners.

ben-eng: 72h SDK drop is tight but doable if vendor keeps ETA. We'll flag any binary changes immediately.

ken-ops: I'll draft the fallback routing doc (internal + partner-facing) and include sample routing JSON for marketplace. sample below:
```json
{
  "sku": "h100",
  "preferred_region": "us-east",
  "fallback": ["us-west","eu-west"],
  "latency_limit_ms": 80
}
```

tara-products: Nice. For marketplace listing we can use a single SKU with a region-availability array. Marketing wants the hero launch to show only primary regions. We'll gate secondary regions with "preorder" copy.

olivia-partners: Action items: 
- ben-eng: stabilize MI300/GAUDI test images and surface any ABI issues (W+1)
- ken-ops: publish fallback routing doc + sample JSON (W+0.5)
- sri-sre: canary run plan and rollback playbook (W+1)
- tara-products: draft Phase 0/1/2 copy for marketplace pages (W+2)
- olivia-partners: coordinate SDK drop window with vendor and integrators (target W+1)

ben-eng: One more caveat: SI integrators requested SSH access to lab nodes for debugging during Phase 0. Ops, is that acceptable?

ken-ops: We can provide bastion access with time-limited credentials and session recording. Will add to the runbook.

sri-sre: Also adding telemetry schema for SI: required metrics include GPU temp, PCIe error count, process-resident memory, and driver version. We'll publish a JSON schema.

vendor-hw-bot: Reminder: embargo rules apply. Partner releases must not mention public availability until "embargo_end" timestamp is set. Use marketplace.template v4.

olivia-partners: OK team, let's treat this thread as the canonical place for any lane/gating changes. If vendor slips beyond W+2, escalate to exec. Thanks all :raised_hands:
